cohort: 190 neonates diagnosed with perinatal asphyxia (defined as history of delayed cry or Apgar score of less than 7 in 5 minutes) admitted to a Special Newborn Care Unit (SNCU).
finding: Perinatal asphyxia accounted for 11.10% of SNCU admissions and 22.91/1000 live births, and was associated with prolonged second stage of labor, obstructed labor, institutional delivery, and maternal hypothyroidism.
